summary: Updates the round-trip time estimation used by TFRC-based congestion control in DCCP by adding a Sender RTT Estimate option. It updates the CCID-3 and CCID-4 specifications and addresses parameter-estimation problems that arise with TFRC-based DCCP congestion control.

eli5.summary: To send data at a good speed you need to know how long a message takes to go and come back. This gives senders a way to share their own measurement so the speed is chosen more accurately.
